assertions.name: control_classical_gevrey_d2_falls
assertions.source: d2 log I(n): 0.055334532 (n=9) -> 0.015756634 (n=29); falls by >2x as classical Gevrey-1/2 requires (d2 ~ 1/2n -> 0)

assertions.name: Z_n_d2_rises_while_control_falls
assertions.source: d2 log Z_n rises 0.17963738 (n=20) -> 0.18620991 (n=29) while the control falls: opposite trends, tolerance-free

assertions.name: R1_order_is_q0_n_squared_not_half
assertions.source: min d2 log Z_n over n>=15 = 0.1761127 > 1.5*ln q_0 = 0.15651108, and d2[29] = 0.18620991 < 2 ln q_0 = 0.20868144. The q_0^(n^2/2) hypothesis predicts d2 -> ln q_0 = 0.10434072, which is 1.78463x below the measured value: REFUTED.

assertions.name: R2_level1_kernel_insufficient
assertions.source: d2 log S^bal rises 0.075296664 -> 0.081869185 and is 5.19586x the control's 0.015756634: S^bal is still q-Gevrey after one level-1 q-Borel division, so that kernel alone does not tame Z_n

assertions.name: R2b_q0_n2_half_belongs_to_S_bal
assertions.source: d2 log S^bal[29] = 0.081869185 lies in (ln q_0 / 2, ln q_0) = (0.05217036, 0.10434072), rising toward ln q_0: S^bal ~ q_0^(n^2/2). That is the order the corpus records for Z_n; it belongs to S^bal = Z_n / q^C(n,2).

assertions.name: structural_identity_Z_eq_Sbal_times_kernel
assertions.source: Z_n = S^bal(n;q_0) * q_0^C(n,2) holds to compute precision for all n in range (C(n,2) is the exponent of QOU.MathlibExt.QBorelKernel.qBorelKernel)

assertions.name: control_involution_numbers_anchor
assertions.source: I(6) = 76 (telephone numbers), the q=1 shadow the superseded transform resummed

assertions.name: R3_squared_level1_kernel_removes_the_quadratic
assertions.source: dividing by q^(n(n-1)) = (q^C(n,2))^2 sends d2 negative and rising to zero: -0.029044056 (n=20) -> -0.022471535 (n=29), where the level-1 kernel alone left d2 rising to a POSITIVE constant. d2 -> 0 is the classical signature: the squared kernel removes the quadratic growth exactly.

assertions.name: R3b_no_integer_qBorelExp_level_suffices
assertions.source: qBorelExp d n = (n/d)(n%d) + d*C(n/d,2) ~ n^2/(2d) is DECREASING in d, so the family's strongest member is d=1 at ~n^2/2, while Z_n needs ~n^2. The required exponent is 2*C(n,2) = n(n-1) -- the level-1 kernel applied TWICE, i.e. a 'half level', which is the ramified level-2 family QBorelKernelLevel.lean:24-27 already names as open.

assertions.name: R3c_residual_asymptotics_NOT_settled_scope_gate
assertions.source: NOT a positive result: T2 = log Z_n - ln q0 * n(n-1) is still POSITIVE and still GROWING at n<=30 (4.8769152 at n=10 -> 7.9977167 at n=29), so the asymptotic regime is not reached and NO claim is made that the transformed coefficients decay or where the q-Laplace transform lands. The same diagnostic on the control reads 0.456852 against a true 1/2, under-reading by ~8.63%, so the ~-0.65 slope estimate is an ESTIMATE, not a measurement.

description: qou-hok7 follow-through: measures WHICH q-Borel kernel the deuteron binding statistic Z_n(q_0) needs, by second differences of log (d2 of a*n^2 is the constant 2a; d2 of the classical Gevrey-1/2 (n/2)log n falls to 0, verified in-probe on the control I(n)). (R1) Z_n ~ q_0^(n^2), NOT the q_0^(n^2/2) recorded in qou-hok7, the 2026-08-21 diagnostic and lever1_transfer_operator_spectral_qgevrey's own docstring -- which contradicts the same docstring's (correct) multiplier slope 2 log q_0, since slope 2a = 2 ln q_0 gives a = ln q_0. (R2) Z_n = S^bal * q^C(n,2) already contains the Lean-proved level-1 q-Borel kernel, and stripping it leaves S^bal ~ q_0^(n^2/2), still q-Gevrey: level 1 alone is not enough. Consequence: a resummation built on the recorded q_0^(n^2/2) divisor is off by a square root and cannot converge. scope-(a); no resummation performed, nothing wired, no fit.
